jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Interoperability and Architecture Design for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT 

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿. Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including: 

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems 
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms 
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team 
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe. 

 

MAIN TASKS 

 

• Lead development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy. 
• Leading the planning and execution of international demonstration campaigns. 
• Support in testing and validation of the multi-agent framework. 
• Contribute to integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles. 
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports.  
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields 

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience. 

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills: 

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English 
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2 
• Good programming skills in Python and/or C++ 
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:  

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI 
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics 
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design 
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards 
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations 
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers. 
Personal skills: 

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team 
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must. 
• You are comfortable working in a complex international, multi-partner environment, fostering constructive collaboration, and resolving interpersonal tensions when needed. 
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS 

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence. 
• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens. 
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study.  
CONTRACT 

• Probable date of recruitment: From 15 October 2026, in consultation with the applicant.  
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours/week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant). 
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until November 2028 (end of iMUGS2 project). There is a high chance for the project to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding.  
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. 
• Holiday pay. 
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS 

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test; 
• End-of-year bonus; 
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member); 
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute); 
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day); 
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month; 
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours; 
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu); 
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week; 
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max); 
• Holidays:  
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)  
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays). 
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...); 
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...; 
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

jobs.occupation: Asset Modeler IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

At BNP Paribas Fortis, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is where security meets innovation. We're transforming how the bank manages access rights, making it smarter, more secure, and future-proof.

As part of our IAM Evolution Squad, you'll help build a modern, compliance-driven identity framework using SailPoint and CyberArk.

You'll join a 10-person team of Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, and Scrum Master based in Montagne Du Parc.

Here, you won't just maintain security, you'll shape its future.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As our Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the driving force behind designing, implementing, and optimizing our PAM solutions.

You'll ensure our security not only meets the highest standards but also evolves with the future.

 

What will you actually do?

• You'll develop and implement access policies that meet strict security and regulatory requirements. You'll guide the evolution of our IAM systems, working closely with IT and business teams to ensure security never comes at the expense of efficiency.
• You'll share your knowledge and train teams in best practices, because strong security starts with everyone who uses it. And you'll optimize processes using KPIs and continuous improvement because security is never truly "done".
• You'll collaborate with IAM specialists and cross-functional teams (IT Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, Risk) to strengthen our security controls. You'll make sure we're always one step ahead.
 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You have a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and are CISSP-certified (or have equivalent experience).
• You bring 10+ years of security experience, with deep knowledge of PAM (CyberArk) and a strong background in IAM, Segregation of Duties, and Role-Based Access Control. You're familiar with SailPoint and Cloud (IaaS/PaaS).
 

But what really sets you apart? 

• You think strategically and analytically: complexity is a challenge, not a barrier.
• You're persuasive and collaborative: you bring teams together and drive decisions forward.
• You're proactive and resilient: thriving in dynamic environments.
• You work with precision and structure, because quality is non-negotiable.
• And you love working in multicultural teams, because diversity is your strength.
• You speak Dutch & French: because we're based in Belgium.
• You are fluent in English (written & spoken): the language of global security.
• Your toolkit: CyberArk ServiceNow SailPoint Process Management tools – the tools you'll use every day.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Operations & Planning:

• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Ensure smooth shift handovers

• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
 

Safety & Quality:

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
 

Performance & Continuous Improvement:

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
